name: onepacerr
description: Automates One Pace downloads, organization, and metadata for Jellyfin (default), Plex, Emby, or a local folder. Read https://github.com/eltharynd/OnePacerr#readme for initial setup and environment variables, especially the first-run pipeline settings. Configure your media server and torrent client credentials using reachable URLs (not localhost), or enable Skip downloads for an existing library. Data maps /mnt/user/data to /data; adjust it to include your library and downloads. If other containers use different paths, set both fields in each mapping pair in Advanced View; otherwise leave both empty. Hardlinks require the same filesystem and volume mount. Runs as 99:100 via Extra Parameters; needs download read access and library read/write access. No appdata volume required. Configure through environment variables; WebUI opens a JSON status report.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Existing share containing your library and torrent downloads. For example, /mnt/user/data/media/tv becomes /data/media/tv inside OnePacerr.

ports.name: Status API port
ports.description: JSON status and health API. There is no graphical configuration interface.

variables.name: Media server
variables.description: Select your media server, or none to organize a local folder. Fill in only the selected server's settings.

variables.name: Series name
variables.description: Series name in your media server and default series folder name.

variables.name: Use hardlinks
variables.description: Enable upstream's hardlink import option. Downloads and library must share the same filesystem and Docker volume mount, such as the single /data mount. Defaults to copying. See the GitHub README for details.

variables.name: Local library root
variables.description: Used only with media server none. Parent directory of the series folder, inside the Data mount.

variables.name: Plex URL
variables.description: Required for plex, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:32400. Use an address reachable from the container, not localhost.

variables.name: Plex token
variables.description: Required for plex. Authentication token for your Plex server.

variables.name: Plex library name
variables.description: Exact name of the TV library in Plex.

variables.name: Jellyfin URL
variables.description: Required for jellyfin, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096. Do not use localhost.

variables.name: Jellyfin username
variables.description: Required for jellyfin. Account with permission to update library metadata.

variables.name: Jellyfin password
variables.description: Required for jellyfin. Password for the selected account.

variables.name: Jellyfin library name
variables.description: Exact name of the TV library in Jellyfin.

variables.name: Emby URL
variables.description: Required for emby, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096. Do not use localhost.

variables.name: Emby username
variables.description: Required for emby. Account with permission to update library metadata.

variables.name: Emby password
variables.description: Required for emby. Password for the selected account.

variables.name: Emby library name
variables.description: Exact name of the TV library in Emby.

variables.name: Torrent client
variables.description: Torrent client with its WebUI/API enabled. Deluge also needs its Label plugin enabled.

variables.name: Torrent client URL
variables.description: Required unless Skip downloads is true. Use a reachable URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080, not localhost.

variables.name: Torrent username
variables.description: Torrent client WebUI username, if the client uses one.

variables.name: Torrent password
variables.description: Torrent client WebUI password.

variables.name: Skip downloads
variables.description: True disables torrent client integration and processes only your existing library.

variables.name: Media server library path
variables.description: Library root as reported by your media server, e.g. /tv. Set together with OnePacerr library path, or leave BOTH empty when paths match.

variables.name: OnePacerr library path
variables.description: Equivalent library root inside this container, e.g. /data/media/tv. Must exist under the Data mount. Set together with Media server library path.

variables.name: Torrent client download path
variables.description: Download root as reported by the torrent client, e.g. /downloads. Set together with OnePacerr download path, or leave BOTH empty when paths match.

variables.name: OnePacerr download path
variables.description: Equivalent download root inside this container, e.g. /data/torrents. Set together with Torrent client download path.

variables.name: Skip existing file verification
variables.description: False hashes existing episodes to check for updated releases. Can take time on large libraries.

variables.name: Skip existing file organization
variables.description: False organizes and renames episodes already in the library.

variables.name: Skip existing metadata updates
variables.description: False refreshes metadata for episodes already in the library. New imports still receive metadata when true.

variables.name: Skip posters
variables.description: True disables poster updates.

variables.name: Include specials
variables.description: Also process special episodes.

variables.name: Prefer extended cuts
variables.description: Prefer extended cuts when available.

variables.name: Prefer alternate cuts
variables.description: Prefer the alternate G-8 cut at the end of Skypiea.

variables.name: Skip supplements
variables.description: Skip alternate edits that supplement incomplete arcs.

variables.name: Include filters
variables.description: Optional comma-separated filters, e.g. S01,S02E01. Empty includes all episodes.

variables.name: Exclude filters
variables.description: Optional comma-separated filters, e.g. S35,S36.

variables.name: Series folder name
variables.description: Optional override. Empty uses Series name.

variables.name: Create missing series
variables.description: Automatically create the series if missing from your media server.

variables.name: Plex skip metadata files
variables.description: For Plex, update metadata through its API without writing NFO and poster files. False also writes those files.

variables.name: Torrent category
variables.description: Category for downloads managed by OnePacerr.

variables.name: Completed torrent category
variables.description: Category assigned after importing completed downloads.

variables.name: Torrent check interval
variables.description: Seconds between checks for completed downloads.

variables.name: Torrent request timeout
variables.description: Seconds to wait for a torrent client response.

variables.name: Metadata poster set
variables.description: Poster set identifier, e.g. default, official, or mizzoufan523. See the project's poster set documentation.

variables.name: Disable metadata WebSocket
variables.description: True uses periodic metadata polling instead of live updates.

variables.name: Metadata check interval
variables.description: Polling interval in seconds; used only when metadata WebSocket is disabled.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: Application log verbosity. Read output through Unraid's container logs.
